name: whoqol-toolkit
description: Scoring (WHO rules), psychometrics and publication-grade statistics for WHOQOL questionnaires (WHOQOL-BREF, -OLD, -100, -HIV, -HIV-BREF, -SRPB, -SRPB BREF, -DIS, EUROHIS-QOL 8) from spreadsheets in Portuguese, English or Spanish: APA tables, figures, XLSX and a methods/results draft in PT, EN and ES.

author.name: Prof. Dr. Fabiano Bezerra Menegidio (LaBiOmicS / UMC)
